title: Covered Units on a Reviewed Remittance — Insulin Pump Program Coverage Note
content:
In the review of a remittance posting on an Insulin Pump Program, the line's covered units per 30 days follow the grant it drew on, in three cases:

1. Where that grant is a payer prior authorization, the standard covered rate is replaced with its units authorized times 30 divided by the days its span covers with both ends included, rounded down.
2. Where that grant rests on the written order itself and an over-limit justification record dated in the 12 months before today is on file, it is replaced with that written order's quantity per 30 days.
3. Otherwise the standard covered rate stands.

The span runs from the grant's valid-from date through its valid-through date, both counted; an over-limit justification record is a clinical document on the program recorded for over-limit justification, dated by its visit date. A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

| Hypothetical grant | Covered units per 30 days |
|---|---|
| Prior authorization, 45 units for a span of 90 days | replaced with 1,350 divided by 90, which is 15 |
| Prior authorization, 40 units for a span of 92 days | replaced with 1,200 divided by 92, 13.04, rounded down to 13 |
| Written-order grant, order 12 per 30 days, over-limit justification 7 months before today | replaced with 12 |
| Written-order grant, no over-limit justification | the standard covered rate stands |
